title: Figures 1-2: petri dish seed setup for wet/dry exposure and seed placement pattern
description: Schematic of the Utah Ranch plant germination experiment. Figure 1, "Sample setup of petri dishes plus seeds (Wet and dry exposures)," shows rows of circles each labeled "10 seeds" grouped as Sweet Corn, Lima Beans, Sugar Snap Peas and Garden Bean under "A. Dry seed exposure" and "B. Wet Seed Exposure," with two complete sets for high- and low-activity areas. Figure 2, "Pattern of seed placement in petri dishes," shows a circle with ten evenly spaced dots.
